messages:
liz: FYI receiving a P1 from a customer — mobile dashboard embed is showing wrong legend mapping and tooltips point to other series. They say metrics themselves are present in the table but charts look incorrect. attaching screenshots + console output.

support-bot: Ticket #9872 created for acme-inc, priority: P1. Link: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/9872 :rotating_light:

liz: repro notes from customer:
1) Open dashboard on iPhone 12 (iOS 16.4) in Safari
2) Switch to 2-column compact view
3) Select time range last 24h
4) Observe legend items reorder after swipe/resize, tooltip points to value from previous series

maria: thanks liz — do we have a console log / network trace? any 500s from metrics API?

liz: attaching console snippet they pasted:
```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'label' of undefined at renderLegend (legend.js:142)
Unhandled Promise rejection: Error: metrics API returned 204 (no content) for /api/v1/dash/query?range=24h
```

jamie: can repro on simulator with narrow viewport. looks like legend items are reflowing and index mapping between legend DOM nodes and chart series breaks when wrap occurs. suspect a race between layout and chart paint.

jamie: quick debug: if I force a re-render after layout (window.requestAnimationFrame -> chart.update()) mapping fixes. so workaround for now is to trigger reflow on resize.

siva: important to check whether this is purely client-side or tied to delayed metrics causing series array length to change mid-render. if API returns 204 then chart library might be skipping series leading to index drift.

liz: customer mentions occasional 204s from metrics API around the same time as UI glitch. they previously had a different dashboard and saw stable behaviour.

mobile-design: can we get screenshots of before/after? any overlap with compact/breakpoints? I can try CSS patch to keep legend in single row with ellipsis as a short-term fix.

jamie: screenshot: https://redwood.app/screens/9872/chart-1.png — see legend order vs colored bars mismatch.

maria: triage plan: (1) add guard in frontend to ignore series reorder while layout is updating; (2) handle 204 from metrics API gracefully by keeping placeholder series until data arrives; (3) ship CSS fallback for mobile to avoid wrapping; (4) notify customer and provide manual workaround: rotate device or refresh.

liz: customer escalated to legal if not fixed within 48h so let's prioritize. cc @siva @jamie please advise ETA.

siva: I'll take lead. jamie + mobile-design pair for quick patch. aiming for hotfix tomorrow EOD. will post PR + canary link here.

jamie: local patch: add `data-series-id` attributes and map tooltip by id instead of index — much safer. pushing PR in ~3h.

mobile-design: temporary CSS: `.chart-legend { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }` prevents wrap and reduces chance of reordering.

liz: thanks all — I'll update the customer with the workaround and that eng has started a hotfix.

support-bot: Ticket #9872 updated: assigned to siva, status: in_progress.
